description: The pie chart illustrates the original distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset, with percentages representing the proportion of utterances for each emotion. The chart is divided into six segments: "Frustration" (25.1%, light blue), "Neutral" (23.1%, dark blue), "Happiness" (14.1%, light purple), "Excitement" (8.1%, light blue), "Sadness" (14.7%, orange), and "Anger" (14.9%, yellow). Each segment is labeled with its corresponding emotion and percentage value, and the slices are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top. The largest segment corresponds to "Frustration," followed closely by "Neutral," while "Excitement" represents the smallest portion of the dataset. The chart uses distinct colors for each category, allowing for clear visual differentiation.
